runs.notes: Thirty-four research workers: cards Q48-Q76 on the digest's holes and today's cold-test questions in four waves, then Q77-Q81 (money if the facility is cancelled, waiting when a custodian fails, new conceit parallels, what makes a reflection convincing, months of zero interest); twenty-four raters judged every row of Q48-Q81 the same day; numbers 8q, 8r and 8s; exhibits rebuilt; an aha-candidate hunt; three cold readers on eight ahas

Thirteen research workers: cards Q82-Q94 (proofs and trade customs; seals and pledges in Taiwan; forecast rules in Taiwan and Japan; building costs and world shares re-derived; giving against means; the price of certainty; implementation shortfall; one issuer; pledges at a discount; dissent in teams; Taiwan's political calendar; why no bond matures 2031-2036; guidance heard as a promise), 482 rows from about 490 sources read at source; thirteen raters judged every row the same evening; five analysis workers (custody balance and the waiting-cash replay, NUMBERS 8t; Figure 1 and Table 2 rebuilt; why a range once both ends are owned; people in the reflection; the coherence and bond readers' fixes) and two fresh voice writers; fifteen readers: panel 3 (three judges), bond desk 4, coherence reader 6, four funders (which figure is booked), three voice readers (round 5) and three cold aha readers

Fourteen research workers on the thinnest tags and short SKELETON parts: cards Q95-Q108 (authors' lumpy advances; a career as bond, stock and option; pension sponsors and recovery plans; the top-up before January 2027 with eight-week moves since 1962; comfort letters and pledges; Taiwan's artist-founded museums; artist-endowed foundations; what $50,000 buys in Taiwan; Taiwan's price adjustment and October's cost index read at source; coupon reinvestment history; fewer numbers, better understood; ink in the ledger; aha moments and memory; graphic novels through downturns), 567 rows from about 495 sources read at source; nine raters judged every row the same morning; six analysis workers (numbers owner: bond desk 4 reproduced and the payments' cost exposure sized; Table 3 cut to one page; the density cut of 3a, 3c and 3e; the aha test brief; landing Q82-Q108 in SKELETON, GEM_LEDGER and REFERENCES; coherence and lay fixes) and two fresh voice writers; eight readers: voice round 6 (three), cold aha test 4 (three), coherence reader 7 and a lay reader

Thirteen research workers: cards Q109-Q121 (reverse stress tests for 3e; reservoir firm yield; aviation fuel categories; Taiwan's rotating credit groups and their law; Taiwanese donor lists and exact sums; pencil and ink in law and archives; one-day move or averaging out; Olympic and Expo guarantees; data freshness; illustrators who founded places; Taiwan's public promises cut and floors; certainty words as numbers; Taiwanese ink, seal and type craft), 519 rows from about 490 sources read at source (many in part or as extracts, each card's Gaps says which); twelve raters judged every row the same evening (store 6,720 ideas); seven analysis workers (the numbers re-size: the ten payments carry the 0.5% cost margin, plan.py's day count fixed, every file swept; the aha test 5 pack and its results; landing Q109-Q121 in SKELETON, CONCEIT, GEM_LEDGER section 11 and REFERENCES 2h; the readers' fixes, 28 of 29) and two fresh voice writers; eight readers: voice round 7 (three), cold aha test 5 (three), coherence reader 8 and a lay reader

Fourteen research workers one level deeper on Q1-Q14 and the thinnest tags: cards Q122-Q135 (merger exit clauses and the two reasons; fractional Kelly and the half kept; world shares from their building blocks; UK pension yield triggers that never fired; prepaid tuition plans; the advance against royalties; certainty words in Chinese for Taiwan; founders' own commitment letters and the Giving Pledge; failure-first forms from accident reports for 3e; Taiwan's building materials, wages and the NT dollar with monthly data since 1991; gift annuity and pre-need reserves; who holds and releases a reserve; can a creator sell her career; months of running money in arts groups), 587 rows from about 520 sources read at source (many in part, each card's Gaps says which); fourteen raters judged every row the same morning (store 7,307 ideas); five analysis workers (numbers: what it takes to break each promise, NUMBERS 8u, and 3e recast failure first; the share forecast from its building blocks on the engine, NUMBERS 8v; the aha test 6 pack and its results; landing Q122-Q135 in SKELETON, GOLDMINE, GEM_LEDGER section 13, REFERENCES and CONCEIT) and two fresh voice writers; eight readers: voice round 8 (three), cold aha test 6 (three, one item per file, one reader from outside fixed income), coherence reader 9 and a lay reader

Fourteen research workers: cards Q136-Q149 (illustrators and image models; the IPS as precommitment in its builders' words; what a late Treasury payment looks like; pledges that go unpaid; why residencies close; binding records in ink far from comics; Taiwan funders' budget calendars; near misses and learning; bill ETFs for waiting money; Taiwan's own arts-building overruns; data freshness, which found Fidelity International's 7.6% and moved the median of published forecasts; how gift offices count a figure; artists' receipts in official data; disagreement in small teams), 534 rows (each card's Gaps says what was read only in part); fourteen raters judged every row the same evening (store 7,841 ideas); eight analysis workers (numbers owner twice: four register slips fixed, the 13 Nov curve range and an early end of the late-2032 fund, NUMBERS sections 3 and 4; exhibits second and third passes; the aha test 7 pack and its results; landing Q136-Q149 in SKELETON, CONCEIT, GEM_LEDGER section 14, REFERENCES 2j and CANON B12-B14; the readers' fixes) and two fresh voice writers; nine readers: voice round 9 (three), cold aha test 7 (three), coherence reader 10, a lay reader and bond desk 5

Twelve research workers: cards Q151-Q162 (bond ETFs that end early or merge; bought deals and firm commitments; dividend policy, Lintner's managers and specials; quasi-option value and staged commitment; subjects, holds and pencilled dates in trades far from comics; what a Taiwan residency costs to run each year; certainty of subject matter and security entitlements; how far an arts nonprofit's running money swings; a range against one figure; deferred pay funded when promised; Taiwan's life insurers and a strong Taiwan dollar; defined-outcome funds as the design the plan refuses), 485 rows (each card's Gaps says what was read only in part); five synthesis workers built 37 syntheses from five clusters of the store's tags (29 kept or adapted, `research/SYNTHESES.md`, card Q150's 28 rows); thirteen raters judged every row of Q150-Q162 the same morning (513 rows: 317 keep, 123 adapt, 73 merged, 0 refuse; store 8,354 ideas); four analysis workers (numbers owner: labels and the one-fund wording, NUMBERS 8w on one fund behind three promises; SKELETON landing and panel 4's fixes; CONCEIT V2.2, GEM_LEDGER and references) and two fresh voice writers; nine readers: panel 4 (three judges), voice round 10 (three), cold aha test 8 (three, eight syntheses and the control)
